id.meaning: Nonempty ASCII lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphens; at most 64 bytes.

title.meaning: Title whose trimmed value is nonempty; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

url.meaning: HTTP or HTTPS URL with a nonempty authority that neither begins with ':' nor contains '@'; no whitespace; at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes.

guest_class.meaning: The guest class accepted by the registry.

admin_only.meaning: Whether this cartridge is restricted to the administrative face.

cartridge.meaning: The admitted cartridge on success, containing id, title, url, guest_class and admin_only.

cartridgeCount.meaning: Number of registry entries after admission.

command.meaning: Command named in a handler error response.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Success or handler error signal. JSON extraction errors can occur before the handler and need not carry this field.
